remarks: Fresh, bright, and conveniently located in the heart of Norwalk's sought-after Spring Hill neighborhood! This one-bedroom, one-bath ranch-style apartment is perfectly situated on the upper floor, offering peace, privacy, and plenty of natural light. The entire unit has been freshly painted, with newly shampooed wall-to-wall carpet that gives a warm, inviting feel. Enjoy the ease of heat and hot water included in your rent, and relax knowing you'll have off-street parking just steps from your door. The smart, efficient layout makes everyday living a breeze - ideal for a professional, medical staff, or anyone seeking comfort and convenience close to it all. You're just a short walk to Norwalk Hospital, and minutes from the SONO Collection Mall, I-95, Route 7, and countless restaurants, shops, and local amenities. Move right in and start enjoying a clean, low-maintenance home in a prime location - ready for its next resident today!
